testimonial.author: Dr. Priya Desai, MD

core_features.title: Everything a dermatology patient — and your front desk — needs.
core_features.description: A single, secure surface for scheduling, communication, clinical workflows, and payments — replacing the 5–7 disconnected tools most clinics wrestle with today.

items.title: Online Appointment Booking
items.desc: Real-time provider calendars, insurance pre-check, and automatic confirmations — 24/7 self-scheduling that fills your chair.

items.title: Secure Patient Messaging
items.desc: HIPAA-encrypted two-way chat between patients, front desk, and clinical staff — with audit trails and read receipts.

items.title: Digital Intake & Consent Forms
items.desc: Encrypted intake, medical history, and e-signature consents completed before the visit — synced straight to your EHR.

items.title: Online Bill Pay & Statements
items.desc: PCI-compliant card, HSA, and FSA payments, payment plans, and paperless statements — collect faster with less friction.

items.title: Prescription Refill Requests
items.desc: One-tap refill requests routed to the correct provider with medication history, allergies, and pharmacy on file.

items.title: Lab Results & Biopsy Reports
items.desc: Release pathology, lab, and biopsy results with plain-English summaries and provider notes patients actually understand.

items.title: Teledermatology Visits
items.desc: Encrypted HD video with waiting room, image upload, and integrated charting — no separate telehealth vendor required.

items.title: Smart Reminders & Recalls
items.desc: SMS + email reminders, annual skin-check recalls, and no-show recovery automations that recover 20–30% of lost revenue.

security.title: HIPAA-aware from the first line of code.
security.description: Not bolted on. Not a checkbox. Every architectural decision — hosting, database, messaging, video, storage, analytics — is designed around PHI protection and OCR-audit readiness.

items.title: HIPAA-Aware Architecture
items.desc: PHI encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3). BAAs signed with every sub-processor.

items.title: Role-Based Access Control
items.desc: Granular permissions for providers, MAs, billers, and front desk — with full audit logging.

items.title: MFA & Biometric Login
items.desc: Passkeys, Face ID, and TOTP for patients and staff. Zero password resets. Zero phishing.

items.title: Family & Caregiver Access
items.desc: Proxy access for parents, spouses, and caregivers with age-based automatic revocation.

workflow.title: From kickoff to live portal in 4–6 weeks.

steps.title: Discovery & EHR audit
steps.desc: We map your current EHR, PMS, and workflows in a 60-minute working session.

steps.title: Portal design & branding
steps.desc: Custom UI matched to your practice — not a generic vendor template.

steps.title: Integrations & migration
steps.desc: EHR, e-Rx, labs, payment, and telehealth wired end-to-end. Patient data migrated cleanly.

steps.title: Staff training & launch
steps.desc: Live training, printed workflows, and a 30-day white-glove hypercare window.

items.q: Is the patient portal HIPAA compliant?
items.a: Yes. Every layer — hosting, database, messaging, video, storage, and analytics — is HIPAA-aware. We sign a BAA and provide a documented compliance package covering encryption, access control, audit logs, and breach response.

items.q: Does it integrate with my EHR?
items.a: We integrate with the major dermatology EHRs (Modernizing Medicine / EMA, Nextech, EZDERM, DrChrono, Athena, eClinicalWorks, Practice Fusion, Epic, Cerner) via HL7, FHIR, or vendor APIs. If you use a niche EHR, we scope a custom integration.

items.q: Can patients book without creating an account?
items.a: Yes. Guest booking is supported for new patients — the portal account is created automatically after the first appointment is confirmed, with a magic-link welcome email.
A single-location portal launches in 4–6 weeks. Multi-location and complex EHR migrations typically take 8–12 weeks including staff training and hypercare.

items.q: Do we own the portal after launch?
items.a: Yes. You own the code, content, branding, and patient data. There is no lock-in, no per-patient fee, and no month-to-month contract required — cancel anytime with full data export.

items.q: Is telehealth an add-on or included?
items.a: Included. HIPAA-compliant HD video with waiting room, image upload, and charting is built into the portal — no separate telehealth vendor or per-visit fee.
